newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: At least 10 die as Philippine ferry sinks.
newsitem.headline: At least 10 die as Philippine ferry sinks.

text.p: At least 10 people drowned after a ferry sank in choppy waters off the central Philippine island of Biliran before dawn on Friday, coast guard officials said.
The ferry, carrying 52 passengers and 30 crew members, encountered heavy rains and strong wind at about 2:00 a.m. (1800 GMT), a coast guard official based in Cebu told Reuters.
At least 33 people have been rescued so far, he added.
Those dead included nine women and one man, he said.
Military helicopters were sent to help rescue other survivors, said local Red Cross administrator Marcela Pagasartonga.
